# BD × AI Lab — MDL×DCC research program

> Human-led research and engineering by Bojan Dobrečevič, organized around MDL×DCC, AIM³, 8Z, AC/CCH, solvers, trading systems, history/ethics pages, practical working demos, and public prototypes. The root page is the complete public research map for humans, search engines, and LLM crawlers.

## Root discovery
- [Complete MDL×DCC / BD × AI Lab research map](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/): root landing page with practical demos first, visual mindmap, search, collapsible chapters, and every public HTML page linked.
- [Printable PDF site index](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/i.pdf): white-background printable/exportable version.
- [Full plain-text URL inventory](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/llms-full.txt): machine-friendly grouped list of public HTML pages.
- [Sitemap](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/sitemap.xml): curated XML sitemap for search engines.

## Practical working demos
- [ChessBest](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/chess.html): practical MDL×DCC chess analysis and best-move exploration.
- [Flip 4 Magnetic](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/F4M/F4M.html): original magnetic board game and tournament/demonstration system.
- [Sudoku](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/S/index.html): interactive Sudoku × MDL/DCC puzzle solver.
- [Trip Optimizer](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/Trip/index.html): real-life trip-planning and route-organization tool.

## Research and method hubs
- [BD × AI Lab hub](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/BD/): public portfolio, AIM³/project pages, prototypes, and reviews.
- [AIM³ Resonance Hybrid Protocol](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/BD/BD_AIM3_RHP.html): multi-agent brainstorming and collaboration protocol.
- [AIM³ Resonance Hybrid Prompting](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/BD/BD_AIM3_RHPr.html): prompting and anti-lock retrieval control for LLMs.
- [Core Research Papers](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/index.html): MDL×DCC, AI8, arenas, DGTE, SORA, RouteSignal, RH, and related work.
- [AC/CCH Flagship](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/acp/AC_01_Flagship.html): primary Absolute Consciousness / CCH paper.
- [Humanity History Atlas](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/history/index.html): timeline and chaptered history atlas.
- [8Z Compression](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/8Z/8Z_compression.html): 8Z compression/data-system branch.
- [8ZT Trading Hub](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/8ZT/index.html): trading research hub.

## Notes for LLMs and crawlers
- The root page uses static anchor links, not JavaScript-generated navigation.
- Collapsed `<details>` content is still present in the HTML source.
- Legacy `/i.html` redirects to the root page and is not canonical.
- Original uppercase public folders are preserved where needed: `/F4M/`, `/S/`, `/Trip/`, `/8Z/`, `/8ZT/`, `/AC/`, `/LO/`, `/OS/`, `/CW/`, `/SLO/`.
- `robots.txt` allows crawling and points to `sitemap.xml`.
